# code of conduct

be kind, and assume the people here mean well. criticize the work, never the person.

harassment, insults, unwelcome sexual attention and posting someone's private details are not accepted, here or anywhere you speak for the project.

to report something, write to the maintainer privately through [a private report](https://github.com/nikhil-yn-aix/fetchloom/security/advisories/new), which only the maintainer can read. it is meant for security, and conduct reports are welcome there too.

the maintainer reads every report, answers within seven days and keeps your name private. depending on what happened, that means a private note, a warning, removing comments or contributions, or blocking someone from the project.
